intCompactDescr.note: optional devices and equipments use nationID = noneIndex = 15; vehicles/components/shells use the real nation id.

vehTypeCompDescr.description: integer compact descriptor of a vehicle TYPE

vehCompDescr.description: binary compact descriptor of one vehicle INSTANCE (inventory 'compDescr' value / makeCompactDescr)
vehCompDescr.layout: u8 header = itemTypeID(vehicle=1) | (nationID << 4); u8 vehicleTypeID; u16 LE chassisTypeID; u16 LE engineTypeID; u16 LE fuelTankTypeID; u16 LE radioTypeID; u16 LE turretTypeID; u16 LE gunTypeID; u8 flags; [u16 LE optionalDeviceTypeID per set device, reverse slot order]; if flags&16 u8 playerEmblemID; if flags&64 u8 hornID; if flags&128 u16 LE camouflageID

flags.0x07: optional device slot mask (3 slots; bit0 = last slot)
flags.0x10: non-default player emblem present (+u8 emblem id)

vehCompDescr.note: 0.6.5 has exactly one turret position per vehicle, so exactly one turret/gun pair is serialized. The client's own default ctor emits a 16-byte variant with one trailing zero byte the parser ignores.

inventorySkeleton.description: Formats from res/scripts/common/AccountDataDefs.txt (server and client vehicle inventory text). One entry per owned vehicle; vehInvID is an account-unique 64-bit id.
inventorySkeleton.note: Every vehicle entry in this catalog carries an 'inventoryEntry' template; assign a unique vehInvID and send one entry per tank to make the garage show it.
